primary_result: All 1,587 independent original-clear-scene groups and four nested haze variants per scene completed in each separately reported known-overlap-quarantined stratum. ITS mean continuous-utility error was 0.8898195655737419 dB with simultaneous interval [0.8558599676054481, 0.9238485154876688] and precision distance 0.03402894991392691 dB. OTS mean error was 1.0656472378845931 dB with simultaneous interval [1.0365580937651073, 1.094736382004079] and precision distance 0.02908914411948582 dB. Although both intervals lie wholly above the frozen 0.05 dB utility margin, the predeclared precision-first terminal mapping requires COMPLETED_INCONCLUSIVE because both precision distances exceed 0.025 dB; the result must not be retrospectively relabeled FAIL.
gate_reasons: ITS precision distance 0.03402894991392691 dB exceeds the frozen 0.025 dB target.
OTS precision distance 0.02908914411948582 dB exceeds the frozen 0.025 dB target.
competing_explanation: The archived Haze4K planning SD of 0.444218872067388 dB underestimated the realized between-scene variation in both target-domain strata: ITS sample SD was 0.602251735447599 dB and OTS sample SD was 0.5170106753649101 dB. The larger observed errors may also reflect genuine indoor/outdoor synthetic-domain heterogeneity or the frozen worst-phase and L-infinity aggregation, but this route does not alter those estimands or identify which explanation dominates.
limitations: The populations quarantine verified known overlaps only and are not fully source-disjoint from Haze4K.
ITS and OTS are separate synthetic-domain strata; they are not pooled as exchangeable scenes and do not establish transport to real haze.
Haze variants, phases, tiles, pixels, actions and bootstrap draws are nested repeats and never increase the independent sample count.
The frozen precision-first terminal mapping forbids a post hoc scientific FAIL despite both reported intervals lying above 0.05 dB.
This development-screening terminal authorizes no training, model selection, confirmation, canary, locked-test, deployment or next-stage experiment.
